rejected_rule.statement: Evidence of the real consideration for a deed of gift can be admitted to establish its irrevocability if it varies the terms of the deed and such evidence entitles the plaintiff to a decree or order relating to the deed.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "In this connection we were referred to Kin Banda v. Saly Marikar[4 C. W. R. 206.] ... The maxim is founded not so much on any positive law as on the broad and universally applicable principles of justice."
